item.title: How Sabotage fantasy football scoring works
item.description: A fantasy football league where the worst plays score. Incompletions, sacks, carries, catches, fumbles, interceptions, missed kicks and defenses that give up points all count. Every NFL player since 1999, ranked by Sabotage points at starsofsabotage.com.
